description: Checklists consumed by tools-audio-delivery.py --checklist, tools-audio-analysis.py audit and tools-catalog-builder.py 'test plan' sections. Each check has a stable id, a measurable pass rule, and the command that measures it.

checks.rule: Final duration is within 2% of the commissioned slot.
Integrated loudness is -16 LUFS +/- 0.5 LU (or the platform target).
True peak is at or below -1 dBTP; no clipped samples.
Every brand term matches the approved pronunciation dictionary entry.
Synthetic-voice disclosure is present in metadata when policy requires it.
A consent or license record covers the use, territory and medium.
Integrated loudness is -18 LUFS +/- 1 LU with true peak at or below -3 dBTP.
Residual noise floor is at least 55 dB below speech level.
No silence longer than 3 s inside a chapter; page-break gaps are intentional and logged.
Names and invented terms follow the project dictionary; regressions are reported.
Speaker identity stays inside 0.5 semitones of the chapter baseline.
Narration voice has documented rights and provenance for the title.
Integrated loudness is -16 LUFS +/- 1 LU for stereo, true peak at or below -1 dBTP.
Channel count and sample rate match the host preset.
No clipped samples in the delivered master.
Episode metadata carries a synthetic-voice disclosure when applicable.
Episode files follow the agreed naming pattern and contain no spaces.
Filenames follow the agreed pattern and are lowercase with no spaces.
Assets are normalised to the engine target (-18 LUFS, -1 dBTP) or left pre-normalised with a note.
Sample rate is 48 kHz mono PCM for engine import.
No unintended leading or trailing silence beyond 80 ms.
Character identity stays consistent within the line set.
Each asset row in the manifest records licence and disclosure status.
Audio is band-limited to 300-3400 Hz and 8 kHz sample rate.
Integrated loudness is -20 LUFS +/- 1 LU with true peak at or below -3 dBTP.
Each prompt is shorter than the menu slot, with 150 ms lead-in and 250 ms tail.
Numbers, codes and menu keys are spoken in the approved format.
Delivered as u-law or 16-bit PCM WAV as required by the switch.
Playback rate can change from 0.5x to 2.0x without pitch inflation or lost words.
Every heading, link and abbreviation has a spoken form in the script.
Long sentences are split so that no spoken sentence exceeds 25 words.
Integrated loudness is -16 LUFS +/- 1 LU with no sudden jumps between sections.
Navigation gaps are 800-1200 ms and never shorter than 400 ms.
